title: Spring cart: damping measured with no ruler in sight
description: A glider on a track between two springs, filmed for 15 s with nothing of known size in view. Frequency and damping don't need a scale, so PhysicsLens identifies a lightly damped oscillator and rejects the undamped one.
credit: Video: Pieter Kuiper, Linnaeus University, Wikimedia Commons, Attribution license (trimmed)
